Card Q&A.a: A token is a special card played from an effect that is treated as a Digimon or Tamer. This card's effect can play tokens treated as Digimon named "Diaboromon." For detailed rules pertaining to tokens, check the rule manual.

Card Q&A.q: Do Diaboromon tokens meet the white color requirement?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Diaboromon] Token without paying its memory cost. (Diaboromon Tokens are level 6 white Digimon with a memory cost of 14, 3000 DP, and are Mega form, Unidentified type, and Unknown attribute.)
